item.title: Saiminjutsu 4
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fudegaki Soft
  • 発売日: 2019-03-29
  • スコア: 7.44/10 (119 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠術４
  • 英語名: Saiminjutsu 4

あらすじ

Ever since the loss of his parents at a young age, the protagonist has been living with his two older sisters. He had a good relationship with his childhood friends and his classmates, and lived a fairly happy life, though always fearful of losing that happiness. But then, abusing the power of “hypnosis” which he had been taught, the protagonist’s life spun out of control…

  • 日本語名: 催眠学園1年生
  • 英語名: Saimin Gakuen 1-nensei

あらすじ

The protagonist is a student of a third rate university with an awkward personality and sullen looks. His interests are deviant as well, but as an adult he has no shame about this. He acts like a stalker, and sneakily digs through the trash in the middle of the night. Naturally he’s avoided by everyone around him.

あらすじ

Hikaru is a normal student, who lives with her parents and younger brother. item.title: Saiminbo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fudegaki Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-11-28
  • スコア: 6.840000000000001/10 (94 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠母
  • 英語名: Saiminbo

あらすじ

The main character Souichi Chiba used to live with his father in a motherless household but since his father passed away two years ago he’s come to live alone. His mother died when he was born and now he’s left without any relatives. Because of this he has a powerful longing for someone to call a mother. Even though he has no mother, he’s come down with a serious mother complex.

item.title: Saiminjutsu Re
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fudegaki Soft
  • 発売日: 2014-05-30
  • スコア: 7.290000000000001/10 (126 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠術Re
  • 英語名: Saiminjutsu Re

あらすじ

Fudegaki Soft’s complete renewal of the original Saiminjutsu developed in 2001! The original madness-inducing contents untouched but with art all newly redrawn and added by Oosaki Shinya of “Tsuboi-kun no Switch!”, along with a new character added! Additionally, as requested by everyone when first sold, a complete renewal has been done with various new scenes added! Art and scenario have been have more than doubly increased in volume!

item.title: Saiminjutsu 3
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fudegaki Soft
  • 発売日: 2013-09-27
  • スコア: 7.540000000000001/10 (142 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 催眠術3
  • 英語名: Saiminjutsu 3

别名

  • Hypnotism 3

あらすじ

Even though the protagonist suffers from a dark past and deviant sexual preferences, he lead a wholesome life thus far because of his warm household and best friend.

Until he coincidentally acquires the power of “hypnosis” and starts using this new power.

His desires start to escalate until he starts destroying things that are dear to him, like his family and friendships.

item.title: Tsuboi-kun no Switch!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Fudegaki Soft
  • 発売日: 2012-07-27
  • スコア: 7.12/10 (120 人評価)
  • 日本語名: つぼい君のスイッチ！
  • 英語名: Tsuboi-kun no Switch!

あらすじ

The main character, Tsuboi Naoki, overdid it in soccer class one day and wore himself out. Afterward, he noticed a sign advertising for a massage service. He thought about paying with his pocket change and getting a masage for his weary body. Since he’d never paid for a massage before, somehow he felt a little more like an adult.
